mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates increase the discount rate for equity cash flows and compress valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases recession risk and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative signal from FEDFUNDS > 5.0% fails when 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 305 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, the combined signal of high inflation and restrictive policy triggers recession fears, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a strong labor market (PAYEMS > 155000) signals robust consumer spending and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive signal from PAYEMS in UNRATE < 4.0% regimes fails when 20-day forward returns are positive in < 40% of instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current employment level (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market supporting consumer confidence and growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive signal from HOUST > 1300 fails when 60-day forward returns are positive in < 40% of instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 690000 million dollars, the combined signal of strong housing and consumer spending leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when 5-day forward returns are positive in < 40% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative signal from INDPRO < 100 fails when 60-day forward returns are negative in < 60% of instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
